What we do

Services

Makeup and hair services at the studio in DHA Phase 3. Call to confirm availability and book your slot.

Bridal Makeup

Complete makeup for your wedding day, done at the studio. Call for appointments and to discuss your date.

Party Makeup

Polished makeup for parties and occasions — ready for the evening, done at the studio.

Haircuts

Haircuts at the studio, available on their own or as part of a wash + blow-dry package.

Wash + Blow-Dry

Wash and blow-dry finishing, offered in packages together with a haircut.

Hair Treatments

Treatments for the care and condition of your hair. Call the salon to ask what is right for you.
